Tcl Gin Fizz
By: The Cocktail Lovers
Published: Tuesday, September 28, 2010 - 8:52am

Ingredients




1 1/2 ounces gin
1/2 ounce sugar syrup
1/2 Juice from lemon
1/2 Juice from lime
Soda water

Preparation

1 Stir all the ingredients (except soda water) in a cocktail mixing jug. 2 Strain in a Collins glass filled with ice. 3 Top with soda water

About


Easy, refreshing and delicious, this is the ideal drink to make and serve when you're in need of something with a few bubbles.
